about: A play the backend replays from its resolution cache, as the e2e specs seed it (electron/lib/e2e-replay.cjs). backend/src/commands/play_resolution_cache_e2e_row_test.rs holds every field here to what the backend reads.
insert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta_cache(key, body, fetched_at, ttl_seconds) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)
